The extraction task is deliberately constrained to evidence in the supplied pages. It must identify the target package, match the vulnerability identifier, distinguish affected and patched ranges, and return one of VERSION_BUMP, CODE_WORKAROUND, or NO_FIX. Newer is not automatically safer when a release belongs to another branch or another package.

The page includes release history, issue references, vendor language, and operational context because real advisory pages are rarely short.
